name: outlook-calendar
description: Connect Microsoft Outlook Calendar for scheduling, daily briefs, event prep, and safe meeting changes.

interface.longDescription: Use Outlook Calendar to summarize a day, compare availability, prepare for meetings, explain Outlook status semantics, and schedule, reschedule, or cancel events through the connected Microsoft Outlook app.
defaultPrompt: For my next 3 meetings today, generate short prep notes: attendees, likely goals, and questions I should ask
Build a weekly plan: group my meetings by theme (customer, internal, hiring, ops) and suggest slots for focus time
Find this week's calendar conflicts. Suggest meetings to delegate, decline, or shorten, and draft a message for each
